interpretation: Two-run within-pair variance is squared difference / 2. Its mean pools pair-specific estimates; it is not precise per-pair variance. Model version and time effects cannot be separated from sampling variability.

earlier_rescan.connexion: none: Q surveys formal prediction-augmented algorithm guarantees while P is an applied deep-learning forecasting and dispatch system for carbon intensity, sharing no claim, mechanism, or dataset that either could act on
earlier_rescan.rationale: Feasibility is 0 because there is no defined artifact to build: Q offers no predictor or algorithm that plugs into P's NCI forecasting/dispatch pipeline, and P's LLM-agent forecasting system is not framed with any consistency-robustness guarantee Q's theory could analyze. Gain is 0 since nothing about P's specific carbon-scheduling content is needed to state this pairing; any applied forecasting-plus-optimization paper would produce the same vacuous overlap with a survey on learning-augmented algorithms.

repeat.connexion: P's day-ahead NCI forecast drives a pure predict-then-optimize carbon scheduler with no fallback guarantee, and Q's learning-augmented-algorithms framework could be used to redesign that scheduler as an online algorithm with a formal consistency-robustness bound tied to NCI forecast error, testable by comparing worst-case emission/cost regret of the augmented scheduler against P's raw forecast-driven dispatch under injected forecast noise.
repeat.rationale: Feasibility is moderate: P's spatial-temporal dispatch (GDLs, MESSs, DDCs) would need to be abstracted into a stylized online-optimization instance before Q's constructions apply, which is nontrivial but standard practice in this literature, so it's demanding rather than trivial. Gain is capped by the fact that the underlying move -- wrap any ML-driven optimizer with a prediction-error-parameterized worst-case guarantee -- applies near-identically to essentially any forecast-then-dispatch paper, so nothing specific to P's LLM multi-agent NCI architecture is doing real work here.
